title: Resumption Of Gas Supply By Shanghai Gas Company, Ltd,

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S.1, Special Branch....94444,
REPORT
Date...Sept....15,...19 37.

Subject................Resumption of gas supply by Shanghai Gas Company, Ltd.
- comments in local Chinese press.

Made by...D.S.. Larby................Forwarded by C Gasson i J

With reference to the comments recently published
in the local Chinese press, regarding the policy of the
Shanghai Gas Company, Ltd. in resuming gas supplies: on the
afternoon of September 14, 1937, the undersigned interviewed
Mr. W.J. Brown, Secretary of the Company, and learned that
a letter, purporting to point out the dangers of supplying
coal gas while the scene of the present hostilities is in
close proximity to the International Settlement, had been
received from the Shanghai First Special District Citizens'
Federation. In acknowledgement of this letter, the Company
merely stated that the danger to which the Federation drew
attention had been duly noted.

The undersigned was also informed that Mr. T.K. Ho,
Deputy .. Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Council, and
Mr. Yu Ya Ching had both communicated with the Company in
connection with the aforementioned subject and had been
informed that the chief engineer had, after careful consideration,
decided that it was safe to resume operations.

The possibility of there being some underlying
significance in the request of the Shanghai First Special
District Citizens' Federation to postpone the resumption of
gas supply was then discussed with Mr. Brown.

According to the Company's figures there are
approximately 9,000 gas consumers located south of the
Soochow Creek who have been affected by the cessation of gas
supplies. It was then calculated that at least $45,000
would have to be spent every month to purchase wood, charcoal
or kerosene in order to secure mediocre cooking facilities
for these former gas consumers. It is therefore obvious

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号............
S.1，特务科....94444，
报告
日期...1937年9月15日。

主题................上海煤气有限公司恢复供气。
- 中文报刊的评论。

制作人...D.S.. Larby................转发人 C Gasson i J

鉴于近期本地中文报刊就上海煤气有限公司恢复供气的政策发表的评论：1937年9月14日下午，具名人与该公司秘书 W.J. Brown 先生进行了面谈，获悉公司收到一封来自上海第一特区市民联合会的信函，该信声称指出在当前战事现场紧邻公共租界的情况下供应煤气的危险性。公司在回复此信时仅表示，已充分注意到联合会所提请关注之危险。

具名人还获悉，上海市政府代理秘书长何德奎（T.K. Ho）(音译) 先生和虞洽卿（Yu Ya Ching）先生均曾就上述事项与公司联系，并被告知总工程师经慎重考虑后，决定恢复运营是安全的。

随后与 Brown 先生讨论了上海第一特区市民联合会要求推迟恢复供气这一请求背后可能存在某种潜在意义的可能性。

根据公司的数据，苏州河以南约有9,000户煤气用户因停止供气而受到影响。据此计算，每月至少需花费45,000元购买木材、木炭或煤油，才能为这些前煤气用户维持一般的烹饪设施。因此显而易见

that there is one business which stands to reap considerable
financial benefit from any stoppage in the regular supply of
gas.
It was further learned that Mr. A.K. Sun, a member
of the staff of the Bureau of Public Utilities, acting on
the instructions of Mr. O.K. Yui, Mayor of Greater Shanghai,
had recently visited the company's offices in order to
acquaint the directors of possible dangers to the gasworks
located at 2524 Yangtszepoo Road in the event of Chinese
aircraft attempting to bomb the Japanese airfield situated
near Point Island.
Regarding the possible dangers resultant from the
striking by stray bullets, shells, bombs, etc. of any gas
containing apparatus it was pointed out that when, during
the Great War, West Hartlepool, a town situated on the east
coast of England, was bombarded by German warships, a number
of shells struck the gasometers of the local gasworks but
failed to cause any great damage.
It appears that an explosion or conflagration might
result if a bomb was to strike the main supply pipe but in
view of the fact that the pipe in question is at least twelve
feet beneath the ground, there is little likelihood of such
a situation arising.
In conclusion, the undersigned was informed that
in the event of a recurrence of aerial bombing similar to
that which marked the early stages of the present hostilities,
the company would not hesitate to cut off all gas supplies.
D.C. (Crime & Special Branches)
D. S. Harley.

有一家企业将从任何定期煤气供应的中断中获得巨大的经济利益。

此外还获悉，公用局职员孙阿康（A.K. Sun）(音译) 先生奉大上海市长俞鸿钧（O.K. Yui）(音译) 先生的指示，最近访问了公司办事处，向董事们告知一旦中国飞机试图轰炸位于小岛（Point Island）附近的日本机场，位于杨树浦路2524号的煤气厂可能面临的危险。

关于含气装置被流弹、炮弹、炸弹等击中可能产生的危险，有人指出，在大战期间，位于英格兰东海岸的哈特尔浦（West Hartlepool）镇遭到德国战舰炮击时，数枚炮弹击中了当地煤气厂的储气罐，但未造成重大损害。

看来，如果炸弹击中主供气管道，可能会导致爆炸或火灾，但鉴于该管道至少位于地下十二英尺深处，这种情况发生的可能性很小。

最后，具名人获悉，如果再次发生类似当前战事初期那样的空袭，公司将毫不犹豫地切断所有煤气供应。
D.C. （刑事科及特务科）
D. S. Harley.

China Times and other local newspapers:

RESUMPTION OF GAS SERVICE NOT FAVOURED

Much concern is being shown by Chinese and
foreign residents towards the resumption of gas service
by the Shanghai Gas Company.
In view of the spontaneous explosion of a gas
pipe on September 8, which resulted in the injuring of some
pedestrians, and the possibility of more serious accidents
occurring at a time when stray bullets and shells are
flying about, a reporter of this paper called on a
responsible person of the Various Circles' Enemy-Resisting
Support Association for his opinion.
The following is the statement made by the person
called upon:- "Coal gas is an acute poison and burns
readily, so that when an underground gas pipe is damaged
by a bomb, stray bullet etc., the people living nearby
are liable to be poisoned and their houses burnt. The
gas also has a high explosive power, and if the gas tank
should be hit by a shell, the calamity resulting from the
explosion would be much greater than that which the shell
itself can cause. For the sake of the safety of the
millions of residents, it is to be hoped that the company
will not resume its business at the present moment. The
people should temporarily cease using gas in consideration
of their own safety."

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

INCIPIENT LABOUR DISPUTE AT BUS CO. QUIETED BY TANGPU

Dissatisfied with the action of the management
in discharging operatives and enforcing labour reduction,
King Chih-ts (金植之) and other representatives of the
employees of the China General Omnibus Company recently
submitted a petition to the local Tangpu and other
government organs requesting them to mediate.
Upon receipt of the petition, the Bureau of
Social Affairs of the Shanghai City Government and the local
Tangpu detailed officials to mediate. The officials
advised the workers to refrain from resorting to rash
acts at this time when a major war of resistance is being
carried on; furthermore, they stated that they had
ascertained that the management had no intention of
discharging workers.
The workers then expressed their understanding,
and the labour dispute has been happily settled.

各位记者认为这一声明只是个笑话。随后日本大使馆发言人出面，表示将就此事项向东京政府请示进一步指示。然而，没有一位外国记者能忍住不对此声明捧腹大笑，该声明已于昨晚通过电报发往各国。相信国际舆论将予以严厉批评。

《时事新报》及其他本地报刊：

不赞成恢复煤气服务

中外居民对上海煤气公司恢复煤气服务表示极大关注。
鉴于9月8日煤气管道自发爆炸导致一些行人受伤，以及在流弹和炮弹横飞之际可能发生更严重事故的可能性，本报记者拜访了各界抗敌后援会的一位负责人以征询意见。
以下是被访者的陈述：“煤气是剧毒气体且易燃，因此当地下煤气管道被炸弹、流弹等损坏时，附近居民容易中毒，房屋可能被烧毁。煤气也具有很高的爆炸力，如果储气罐被炮弹击中，由此引发的爆炸灾难将远大于炮弹本身造成的灾害。为了数百万居民的安全，希望贵公司目前不要恢复营业。民众出于自身安全考虑，应暂时停止使用煤气。”

《民报》及其他本地报刊：

唐浦平息巴士公司初起劳资纠纷

因不满管理层解雇工人和强制裁员的做法，中国公共汽车公司职工代表金植之（King Chih-ts）等人近日向当地唐浦及其他政府机关提交请愿书，请求调解。
上海市社会局及当地唐浦接到请愿书后，派遣官员进行调解。官员劝告工人在正在进行重大抗战之际，避免采取鲁莽行动；此外，他们表示经查实，管理层并无解雇工人的意图。
工人们随后表示理解，劳资纠纷得以圆满解决。

September 6, 1937. Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-
CITIZENS' FEDERATION IMPRESSES GAS COMPANY WITH DANGERS
OF RE-OPENING

Yesterday the Shanghai First Special District
Citizens' Federation sent the following letter to the
Shanghai Gas Company, a British concern:-
"We are in receipt of a letter from the
Shanghai Restaurant Owners' Association which states:-
'It is learnt from the local press
that the Shanghai Gas Company, a British concern,
will resume business and continue to supply its local
subscribers with gas commencing from Monday. It must
now be remembered that the Shanghai Gas Company is
situated at the south end of Thibet Road Bridge, a
place that is well adjacent to Chinese territory, and
in case of any disaster, which is not at all unlikely
in view of the wide range of stray shells, etc., the
consequences to the local population will be most
deplorable. Your Federation is, therefore, requested
to open negotiations with the company in question for
the postponement of its resumption of business, in
the interest of the local residents.'
"In view of the foregoing, we, therefore,
earnestly request your company to postpone the resumption
of business."

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-
RICSHA OWNERS' ASSOCIATION MEETS TO DISCUSS LICENCE QUESTION

In view of the hostilities, coupled with
the fact that many vehicles have been destroyed and the
number of ricsha coolies reduced as well as due to the fact
that the authorities are placing a restriction on the
issue of licences, the Special District Office of the
Shanghai Ricsha Owners' Association held an urgent meeting
at 10 a.m. yesterday to discuss ways and means to deal
with the licence question. It is learnt that a further
meeting will be called as soon as a reply has been received
from the S.M.C.

China Times and other local newspapers :-
ACTION REQUESTED TO FORCE FRENCH COMPANY TO ACCEPT WATER
AND ELECTRICITY PAYMENTS BY CHEQUE

Mr. Tu Yueh-sung (杜月笙), Chairman of
the Chinese Ratepayers' Association of the French Concession,
yesterday sent a letter to the French Municipal Council
requesting it to instruct the Compagnie Francaise de Tramways
et d'Eclairage Electriques de Shanghai to accept cheques
from residents in payment for water and electricity charges.

1937年9月6日。晨间译文。

《民报》及其他本地报刊：
市民联合会向煤气公司强调重新开业的危险

昨日，上海第一特区市民联合会致函英商上海煤气公司，信件内容如下：
“本会收到上海酒楼业同业公会来函称：
‘据本地报刊报道，英商上海煤气公司将于周一恢复营业，继续向本地用户供应煤气。必须记住，上海煤气公司位于西藏路桥南端，该地与中国领土毗邻，鉴于流弹等射程广泛，发生灾难并非不可能，一旦发生，对当地居民的后果将极为悲惨。因此，恳请贵会与该公司交涉，为了当地居民的利益，推迟其恢复营业。’
‘鉴于上述情况，本会恳请贵公司推迟恢复营业。’”

《民报》及其他本地报刊：
人力车业主协会开会讨论执照问题

鉴于战事，加上许多车辆被毁、人力车夫数量减少，以及当局限制发放执照，上海人力车业主协会特区办事处于昨日上午10时召开紧急会议，讨论处理执照问题的办法。据悉，一旦收到工部局的回复，将再次召开会议。

《时事新报》及其他本地报刊：

要求采取行动迫使法商公司接受支票支付水电费

法租界华人纳税会主席杜月笙（Tu Yueh-sung）先生昨日致函公董局，要求其指令上海法商电车电灯公司（Compagnie Francaise de Tramways et d'Eclairage Electriques de Shanghai）接受居民以支票支付水电费。
